weather_source: Open-Meteo archive (ERA5 reanalysis): observed daily weather for 2021-22. Boond was given the following days' observed weather as its forecast (perfect foresight) and did not trust forecast rain, because the archive has no rain probability.

baseline.name: PAU calendar
baseline.source: Punjab Agricultural University, Package of Practices for Crops of Punjab - Rabi 2025-26, p.17 (https://pau.edu/content/ccil/pf/pp_rabi.pdf)
baseline.description: PAU schedule for wheat sown by 21 Nov: a first irrigation of 50 mm on day 28, then 75 mm irrigations 5.5, 5.5 and 4 weeks apart (mid-points of PAU's ranges). Each interval is extended by 5 days per cm of rain until 31 January and 2 days after, crediting at most 75 mm of rain per interval. No irrigation after 03-31 (MM-DD). Litres and kWh count the pumped water (net depth / 0.7 application efficiency).
